question: Indian economy is seen growing at ______ per cent in the current fiscal, finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman said while presenting the Union Budget 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**9.2.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indian economy** is seen growing at **9.2 per cent** in the current fiscal, finance minister **Nirmala Sitharaman** said while presenting the Union Budget 2022.
 
• The statement mentions that the Indian economy is expected to grow at** 9.2% in the current fiscal year.**
